Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup expr.opaque (an opaque expression of another dialect has no Drone form)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (rules) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup job.if (condition not expressible in Drone CI; the document disabled)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile/step/script step.shell (Drone compiles commands into its own set -e script that runs under /bin/sh; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.push (the document is disabled, so the trigger is not written)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag (the document is disabled, so the trigger is not written)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.finally: a document that depends on every other document and runs on trigger status success and failure (the server skips a stage whose status filter does not match the build result)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/cleanup job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/compile job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
